description: This file is a C source code implementation related to line logging, diff computation, and range management in a version control or diffing system. It includes functions for managing ranges of lines, diff ranges, and tracking line log data for commits, with operations for sorting, merging, copying, and filtering ranges. It also contains logic for parsing line-specific data, applying diffs, and integrating with commit structures to support blame or blame-like functionalities across commits.
